interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.50.0 adds an opt-in, read-only health-check flag, --worktree-heads, that lists registered linked worktrees whose detached HEAD no branch or tag contains, with a guide for landing linked-worktree work on master; the repository's own CI now cancels a pull request's older run when a newer commit arrives on that pull request, while master, tag, candidate-branch and manual runs are never cancelled. Without the new flag the health check output is unchanged apart from the version surfaces and --help, where argparse adds the option to the usage block (one more usage line at the default width) and one option line, and realigns the six existing option lines by one column. The v0.49.0 task workflow helpers and the generated antigravity/ package remain supported; no real agy conversation was run. The seven certificate-bound checker files are unchanged from v0.46.0 through v0.50.0. Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime. Publication does not upgrade active installations or vaults. For transitions from v0.45.1 or earlier, where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again.
